verifier_note: Checked every warrant against pinned crate source at ~/.cargo/registry/src/index.crates.io-1949cf8c6b5b557f/ (parry3d-f64-0.30.2, rapier3d-f64-0.35.3), live docs.rs/rapier.rs/GitHub-raw/Khronos pages, and si-rpg-engine via gh api (read-only, main). Independently reran four of the five flagged high-stakes claims through compile_oracle.py file mode with my own counter-examples, not copied from the lane's checks: coplanar convex_hull (own 5-point pentagon) -> Some(mass=0); TriMesh::with_flags on a fresh degenerate BadTriangle case -> is_ok=true, topology_is_some=false, while set_flags on the same mesh correctly returns Err; heightfield scale with independently chosen dimensions -> cell_width = scale.x/(ncols-1), proving rapier3d-f64 0.35.3's own ColliderBuilder::heightfield doc text ('Size of each grid cell') wrong; and an airborne, never-grounded character with zero vertical intent still autostepped onto a step (dy=0.16, grounded=true), proving handle_stairs never reads grounded_at_starting_pos despite the 0.36 guide's claim that autostep needs floor contact first. The fifth (vertex order under MERGE_DUPLICATE_VERTICES) was confirmed by direct source read instead of re-executed: HashablePartialEq hashes raw bytes while Eq is by value, a Hash/Eq contract break that explains the size-dependent welding. One defect found: recipe 1's engine_note claims rapier_law.rs 'builds only ColliderBuilder::cuboid colliders ... every body', but current main (solver/src/rapier_law.rs:425-431) builds ColliderBuilder::capsule_y for driven bodies with shape==1. Systemic weakness: engine_note prose about si-rpg-engine's own current source carries no citation, so it is the one place narrative can drift from the live repo unnoticed -- every parry/rapier API and docs.rs claim in this lane held up; the single defect was an uncited claim about 'current' engine state.

verdicts.verify_note: engine_note wrong: rapier_law.rs:425-431 on main builds ColliderBuilder::capsule_y for driven+shape==1 bodies, not only cuboid. All parry/rapier API claims confirmed on docs.rs + the rapier.rs colliders guide.
